# Test fixture notice

`csvdownloads.html` is the real, unmodified downloads-listing page from
retrosheet.org/downloads/csvdownloads.html, saved for offline tests. It is small enough
(~22 KB) to keep in full rather than trim.

`1927csvs.zip`, `1956csvs.zip` and `2001csvs.zip` are trimmed real season zips (all 7
tables), keeping: Babe Ruth's 1927 season (`ruthb101`), Barry Bonds' 2001 season
(`bondb001`), Don Larsen's 1956 World Series Game 5 perfect game (`NYA195610080`), and a
handful of other whole games (kept consistently across all 7 tables, so every table's rows
reference the same games) for structural variety.

Underlying data: The information used here was obtained free of charge from and is
copyrighted by Retrosheet. Interested parties may contact Retrosheet at
"www.retrosheet.org".
